Before you enquire

Questions from
hub teams.

A few details help our team start the right conversation.

Can we ask about more than one hub?＋

Yes. List each pickup point and the shifts you need there. If two hubs share a delivery area, flag it so the field team can plan around the overlap.

Do we need to provide the vehicles?＋

Tell us which riders will need a vehicle. Some riders use their own; the team can check rental EV availability and eligibility for the rest.

How do we confirm rates and a start date?＋

Share the location, headcount, shifts and intended start date. The team can then discuss local availability, commercial terms and onboarding before you commit.

Who follows up on a payout discrepancy?＋

The operations team checks the company paysheet, rider assignment, deductions and bank transfer result. Include the hub and pay period when you raise a query.
